title: The CompBioBench question catalog
text: CompBioBench benchmark, developed Genentech, evaluating LLM coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, …) computational biology tasks. benchmark question poses concrete bioinformatics problem – identifier translation, metadata recovery sequencing file, interpreting genomic locus, reproducing published analysis, – may reference one data files agent needs order answer. compbiobench-runner’s run_benchmark.py drives agent question isolated conda environment records agent’s answer, reasoning trace, token/cost usage. CBBBioc packages question metadata benchmark data element v1qs, provides cbb_url() resolve referenced file location cloud storage, provides cbb_setup_workspace() stage workspace/ + prompt.md folder question exactly compbiobench-runner , question set can explored, individual questions worked, R. See vignette("setup_workspace") vignette workflow end end. vignette narrative, browsable tour question catalog .

text: Genentech’s compbiobench-runner benchmarks LLM CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, …) computational biology questions. question builds per-question folder containing workspace/ directory (holding input files question references) prompt.md describing task, launches agent inside folder. CBBBioc catalogs question set, v1qs data element, provides cbb_url() locate input file cloud storage. vignette demonstrates cbb_setup_workspace(), stages folder single v1qs question shape compbiobench-runner uses, agent (person) can pointed workspace_dir given prompt work .
